description: The cleaning-company strike crisis was reported resolved by 5 December, but neither body gives the first strike date; the strike may have begun in November or December.
required_followup: Locate contemporaneous dated reports from late November/early December or worker/contractor records to establish first collective action and onset month.

description: No source gives participant count, a 50-plus estimate, gathering location or evidence that the work stoppage included a public gathering.
required_followup: Find a contemporaneous report or organizer/worker record documenting number present together, where they gathered and whether the action was a public sit-in/march or only a workplace strike.

description: Sources identify unpaid wages to contractor workers and government payment of arrears to companies; they do not establish whether workers demanded state action or pursued only private-employer wage claims.
required_followup: Seek worker/union statements or contemporaneous reporting specifying employer, demand addressee and the relevant state contracting/payment policy.

description: The U.S. State Department custom report target returned tool text “Exception: forbidden” without HTTP status; no body or report year was verified. Similar wording appeared later in an older report search hit, so its snippet is not evidence for the 2024 candidate.
required_followup: Do not retry the denied URL or access an alternate copy. Use independent permitted contemporary Arabic/English sources to resolve onset, turnout and demand target.

description: Open-web searches covered early and late December and education/labor dimensions, but not the manual’s LexisNexis corpus or a complete local newspaper archive.
required_followup: If accessible, search date-ranged local Arabic/regional news and labor union records, then update only if new actual evidence supports the event fields.
